answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network binds agent identities to a cryptographic vault where each identity registration enforces verifiable stake burning. Under an orchard growth curve, the protocol scales registration burns superlinearly: minting n counterfeit nodes requires burning tokens proportional to n^2. An adversarial raven coordinator attempting mass identity spoofing faces quadratic economic friction, making large-scale coordination attacks mathematically cost-prohibitive.
